description: Vital Signs: Seaport Activity by Major Port (2022) is a dataset listed in Metropolitan Transportation Commission open data portal (data.bayareametro.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Metropolitan Transportation Commission. Vital Signs: Seaport Activity by Major Port (2022) VITAL SIGNS INDICATOR Seaport Activity (EC18) FULL MEASURE NAME Shipping containers moved (TEUs) LAST UPDATED June 2022 DESCRIPTION Seaport activity refers to the quantity of goods moved into or out of the region through seaports. Coverage: San Francisco Bay Area. The portal files it under the category Economy. Its tags are vital signs 2.0, vital signs, ec18. The table has 5 columns. The portal shows 2022-06-13 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-bayareametro-gov-portal.
